[![Windows Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Windows%20x64%20(Alpha)-blue?logo=windows)](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-windows-x64.zip)
[![Linux Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Linux%20x86__64%20(Alpha)-orange?logo=linux)](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)
[![CI Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/actions)
[![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Community-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/neWFpX9ps7)

**SkyRecompiled** is a native ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompilation PC port of *Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky*, built on [`ndsrecomp`](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/ndsrecomp) and [`pmdsky-debug`](https://github.com/UsernameFodder/pmdsky-debug).

### Downloads (v0.1.0 Alpha)

| Platform | Build Status | Package |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **macOS Apple Silicon (`arm64`)** | Verified Working | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-macos-arm64.zip](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-macos-arm64.zip) |
| **Windows (`x86_64`)** | Untested Alpha (Testers Needed!) | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-windows-x64.zip](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-windows-x64.zip) |
| **Linux (`x86_64`)** | Untested Alpha (Testers Needed!) | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-linux-x86_64.tar.gz](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) |

> **Clean-Room & Legal Notice:** This repository contains **zero** copyrighted Nintendo DS ROMs, extracted assets, BIOS/firmware dumps, or ROM-derived C code. Players must supply their own legally dumped *Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky* `.nds` cartridge image. No Nintendo DS BIOS or firmware files are required (`FreeBIOS` + synthesized NVRAM direct boot).

---

## Features & Roadmap

- **Milestone 1 (Pre-Alpha -- Active):** Native **macOS Apple Silicon (`arm64`)** static recompilation of all **34 executable modules** (`arm9`, `itcm`, `arm7` + WRAM/RAM drivers, and all 32 active overlays -- `91,872` recompiled functions), BIOS-free direct boot, 128 KiB FRAM/EEPROM saves, savestates, audio, and controller support.
- **Milestone 2:** Native **Windows (`x86_64`)** and **Linux (`x86_64` / `arm64`)** builds & packaging.
- **Milestone 3:** **Beyond-Emulator Graphics & Smoothness** -- True `16:9` / `21:9` native 2D widescreen (`overlay29` & `overlay11` camera/tile hooks + anchored HUD), **120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz** sub-pixel camera & sprite interpolation, and custom Apple Metal / `SDL_GPU` pixel-art & weather shaders.
- **Milestone 4:** **Launcher, SkyTemple Mod Loader & Online Rescue Board** -- Zero-recompile layered NitroFS mod overrides, SkyTemple custom ASM hack recompilation, and an asynchronous *Rescue Team DX*-style Online Rescue Bulletin Board backed by vanilla **Wonder Mail S / SOS / A-OK Mail** structs (with 54-character passwords preserved forever as an offline fallback).

See [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full technical specification.

### Opening and using in-game settings

Press **F1** during gameplay, or press **Guide** on a controller. You can also
open settings with **Select+Start**. On iPhone or iPad, tap the **⚙** button in
the on-screen controls. The settings open on the category list:
**Video**, **Controller**, **Keyboard**, and **System**. Use the arrow keys or
D-pad to choose a category and press **Enter** or **A** to open it. Press
**Escape** or **B/Back** to return to the category list; press it again to close
settings.

In **Controller** or **Keyboard**, select an action such as **A** or **Up** and
press **Enter** or **A**. Then press the controller button, move the stick, or
press the keyboard key you want to assign. **Backspace** clears a binding;
**Escape** or **Guide** cancels assignment. Each page has a **Restore defaults**
action. On iOS, a connected keyboard or controller can assign inputs; the touch
controls remain available on screen.

### Can I play a European ROM in another language?

The European cartridge includes English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
SkyRecompiled's generated firmware currently selects English, so the European
game starts in English. A **Game language** setting is planned for Explorers
of Sky’s own options menu. It will show the languages available on your
cartridge and apply your choice on the next launch. The USA release contains

int main(int, char**) {
    @autoreleasepool {
        NSFileManager* files = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
        NSURL* documents = [files URLsForDirectory:NSDocumentDirectory
                                         inDomains:NSUserDomainMask].firstObject;
        NSURL* support = [files URLsForDirectory:NSApplicationSupportDirectory
                                       inDomains:NSUserDomainMask].firstObject;
        NSURL* romFolder = child(support, @"Cartridge");
        NSURL* rom = child(romFolder, @"game.nds");
        NSURL* console = child(support, @"Console");
        NSURL* logs = child(documents, @"Logs");
        NSURL* saves = child(documents, @"Saves");
        NSError* storageError = nil;
        for (NSURL* directory in @[romFolder, console, logs, saves]) {
            if (![files createDirectoryAtURL:directory withIntermediateDirectories:YES
                                  attributes:nil error:&storageError]) break;
        }

        if (!storageError && ![files changeCurrentDirectoryPath:console.path]) {
            storageError = [NSError errorWithDomain:NSPOSIXErrorDomain code:errno userInfo:nil];
        }
        if (!storageError) {
            [romFolder setResourceValue:@YES forKey:REDACTED error:nil];
            NSURL* latest = child(logs, @"latest.log");
            NSURL* previous = child(logs, @"previous.log");
            [files removeItemAtURL:previous error:nil];
            [files moveItemAtURL:latest toURL:previous error:nil];
            FILE* log = std::freopen(latest.fileSystemRepresentation, "w", stderr);
            if (log) std::setvbuf(log, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
            NSString* build = [[NSBundle mainBundle] objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"CFBundleVersion"];
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[launcher] SkyRecompiled build %s\n", build.UTF8String);
        }
        SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_TOUCH_MOUSE_EVENTS, "1");
        return show_launcher(rom, console, documents, saves, storageError,
                             storageError.localizedDescription) ? 0 : 1;
    }
}

+### Opening and using in-game settings
+
+Press **F1** during gameplay, or press **Guide** on a controller. You can also
+open settings with **Select+Start**. On iPhone or iPad, tap the **⚙** button in
+the on-screen controls. The settings open on the category list:
+**Video**, **Controller**, **Keyboard**, and **System**. Use the arrow keys or
+D-pad to choose a category and press **Enter** or **A** to open it. Press
+**Escape** or **B/Back** to return to the category list; press it again to close
+settings.
+
+In **Controller** or **Keyboard**, select an action such as **A** or **Up** and
+press **Enter** or **A**. Then press the controller button, move the stick, or
+press the keyboard key you want to assign. **Backspace** clears a binding;
+**Escape** or **Guide** cancels assignment. Each page has a **Restore defaults**
+action. On iOS, a connected keyboard or controller can assign inputs; the touch
+controls remain available on screen.
+
 ### Can I play a European ROM in another language?
 
 The European cartridge includes English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
SkyRecompiled -- Multi-Platform Alpha Release Packager
=====================================================
Packages SkyRecompiled for distribution across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
Every package includes:
  - First-run GUI ROM selector and setup UI (with clean SHA-1 validation)
  - Persistent save/settings redirection to standard OS directories
  - Complete control presets (modern gamepad & keyboard dungeon crawl)
  - Clean-room legal compliance (zero proprietary assets or ROMs bundled)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import platform
import shutil
import stat
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import zipfile

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

CONFIG_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "config"
DIST_DIR = BUILD_DIR / "dist"

VERSION = "0.1.0-alpha"

WINDOWS_BAT = """@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -File "%~dp0SkyRecompiled.ps1" %*
set "exit_code=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if %exit_code% NEQ 0 (
    pause
)
exit /b %exit_code%
"""

WINDOWS_PS1 = """# SkyRecompiled -- Windows Native Launcher & ROM Setup
param([switch]$CheckRunner)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RunnerExe = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "bin\\nds_runner.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $RunnerExe -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Error "Missing bin\\nds_runner.exe. Extract the entire Windows ZIP before launching. If the ZIP has no runner, follow the Windows source build instructions in the project README."
}
$SdlDll = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "bin\\SDL3.dll"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SdlDll -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Error "Missing bin\\SDL3.dll. Extract the entire Windows ZIP before launching."
}
$GameToml = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "config\\game.toml"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $GameToml -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Error "Missing config\\game.toml. Extract the entire Windows ZIP before launching."
}
if ($CheckRunner) {
    & $RunnerExe --help
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

$CleanUsaSha1 = "5fa96ca8d8dd6405d6cd2bad73ed68bc73a9d152"
$CleanEuSha1  = "c838a5adf1ed32d2da8454976e5b1a1aa189c139"

$AppData = [Environment]::GetFolderPath("ApplicationData")
$UserDir = Join-Path $AppData "SkyRecompiled"
$SavesDir = Join-Path $UserDir "saves"
$ConsoleDir = Join-Path $UserDir "console"
$SettingsFile = Join-Path $UserDir "settings.toml"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $SavesDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ConsoleDir | Out-Null

function Test-RomSha1($path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $false }
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA1).Hash.ToLower()

}

function Show-Alert($title, $msg) {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
    [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show($msg, $title, [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBoxButtons]::OK, [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBoxIcon]::Error)
}

function Pick-Rom() {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
    $dialog = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog

$SavestateDir = Join-Path $UserDir "savestates"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $SavestateDir | Out-Null

Write-Host "Launching SkyRecompiled..." -ForegroundColor Green

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/scripts/launcher.py" "$@"
else

    exit 1
fi

    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(pkg_dir):
            for file in files:
                p = Path(root) / file
                arcname = p.relative_to(pkg_dir.parent)
                zf.write(p, arcname)

    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:windows:done]\033[0m {zip_path} ({zip_path.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return zip_path


def package_ios() -> Path:
    """Package the ROM-free iOS alpha IPA for distribution."""
    print(f"\033[1;36m[package:ios]\033[0m Packaging iOS Alpha IPA Distribution...")
    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ipa_source = BUILD_DIR / "ios" / "SkyRecompiled-iOS-alpha.ipa"
    if not ipa_source.is_file():

    shutil.copy2(ipa_source, ipa_dist)
    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:ios:done]\033[0m {ipa_dist} ({ipa_dist.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return ipa_dist


def main() -> None:
    """Parse arguments and create distribution packages for specified platforms."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SkyRecompiled Release Packager")
    parser.add_argument("--platform", choices=["macos", "linux", "windows", "ios", "all"], default="all")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--without-game-banks",
        action="store_true",
        help="macOS/Linux/Windows: package the build from build/runner-fallback",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.without_game_banks and args.platform == "ios":
        parser.error("--without-game-banks is not supported for --platform ios")

    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    host_system = platform.system()

    if args.platform == "macos" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Darwin"):
        package_macos(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "linux" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Linux"):
        package_linux(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "windows" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Windows"):
        package_windows(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "ios" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Darwin"):
        package_ios()

    print("\n\033[1;32mAll release packages generated in build/dist/\033[0m")
    for f in DIST_DIR.iterdir():
        print(f"  - {f.name} ({f.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
name: SkyRecompiled CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # ── macOS (Apple Silicon arm64) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  build-macos:
    name: macOS (Apple Silicon arm64)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Homebrew Dependencies
        run: |
          brew install cmake ninja sdl3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"

      - name: Bootstrap Third-Party Dependencies
        run: |
          ./scripts/setup_third_party.sh

      - name: Run PMDSky Bindings Generator & Full Test Suite
        run: |
          python3 translator/gen_pmdsky_bindings.py --strict
          python3 -m unittest discover tests/

      - name: Build Static Recompiler & Run Test Suite
        run: |
          cmake -S translator -B build/cmake/recompiler -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DSKY_RECOMPILER_OUTPUT_DIR="$PWD/build/recompiler"
          cmake --build build/cmake/recompiler
          ctest --test-dir build/cmake/recompiler --output-on-failure

      - name: Generate FreeBIOS Banks
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/generated_bios
          build/recompiler/nds_recompile --config third_party/ndsrecomp/bios/freebios9.toml \
            --bin third_party/ndsrecomp/third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm9.bin \
            --out build/generated_bios --bank freebios_arm9 --shards 1
          build/recompiler/nds_recompile --config third_party/ndsrecomp/bios/freebios7.toml \
            --bin third_party/ndsrecomp/third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm7.bin \
            --out build/generated_bios --bank freebios_arm7 --shards 1
          echo "// Clean-room stub" > build/generated_bios/arm9_bios.c
          echo "// Clean-room stub" > build/generated_bios/arm7_bios.c
          echo '#include "runtime_arm.h"' > build/generated_bios/arm9_bios_dispatch.c
          echo 'const NdsDispatchEntry g_dispatch_arm9_bios[] = {}; const unsigned g_dispatch_arm9_bios_len = 0;' >> build/generated_bios/arm9_bios_dispatch.c
          echo '#include "runtime_arm.h"' > build/generated_bios/arm7_bios_dispatch.c
          echo 'const NdsDispatchEntry g_dispatch_arm7_bios[] = {}; const unsigned g_dispatch_arm7_bios_len = 0;' >> build/generated_bios/arm7_bios_dispatch.c

      - name: Build macOS Runner (cartridge runtime execution)
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build.py --without-game-banks

      - name: Package and Smoke Test macOS Distribution
        run: |
          python3 scripts/package_release.py --platform macos --without-game-banks
          zip_path=(build/dist/SkyRecompiled-*-macos-arm64.zip)
          test_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/macos-package-test"
          mkdir -p "$test_dir"
          unzip -q "${zip_path[0]}" -d "$test_dir"
          runner="$test_dir/SkyRecompiled.app/Contents/MacOS/nds_runner"
          test -x "$runner"
          file "$runner" | grep -E "Mach-O 64-bit.*arm64"
          "$runner" --help >/dev/null

      - name: Upload macOS Recompiler Binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: skyrecompiled-recompiler-macos-arm64
          path: build/recompiler/nds_recompile
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Upload macOS Application Package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: skyrecompiled-app-macos-arm64
          path: build/dist/SkyRecompiled-*-macos-arm64.zip
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # ── Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  build-linux:
    name: Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

        run: |

      - name: Build Static Recompiler & Run Test Suite
        run: |
          cmake -S translator -B build/cmake/recompiler -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DSKY_RECOMPILER_OUTPUT_DIR="$PWD/build/recompiler"
          cmake --build build/cmake/recompiler
          ctest --test-dir build/cmake/recompiler --output-on-failure

      - name: Generate FreeBIOS Banks
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/generated_bios
          build/recompiler/nds_recompile --config third_party/ndsrecomp/bios/freebios9.toml \
            --bin third_party/ndsrecomp/third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm9.bin \
            --out build/generated_bios --bank freebios_arm9 --shards 1
          build/recompiler/nds_recompile --config third_party/ndsrecomp/bios/freebios7.toml \
            --bin third_party/ndsrecomp/third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm7.bin \
            --out build/generated_bios --bank freebios_arm7 --shards 1
          echo "// Clean-room stub" > build/generated_bios/arm9_bios.c
          echo "// Clean-room stub" > build/generated_bios/arm7_bios.c
          echo '#include "runtime_arm.h"' > build/generated_bios/arm9_bios_dispatch.c
          echo 'const NdsDispatchEntry g_dispatch_arm9_bios[] = {}; const unsigned g_dispatch_arm9_bios_len = 0;' >> build/generated_bios/arm9_bios_dispatch.c
          echo '#include "runtime_arm.h"' > build/generated_bios/arm7_bios_dispatch.c
          echo 'const NdsDispatchEntry g_dispatch_arm7_bios[] = {}; const unsigned g_dispatch_arm7_bios_len = 0;' >> build/generated_bios/arm7_bios_dispatch.c

      - name: Build macOS Runner (cartridge runtime execution)
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build.py --without-game-banks

      - name: Package and Smoke Test macOS Distribution
        run: |

"""

LINUX_DESKTOP = """[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=SkyRecompiled
Comment=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky -- Native Static Recompilation PC Port
Exec=SkyRecompiled
Icon=applications-games
Terminal=false
Categories=Game;Emulator;
"""

README_TEXT = f"""SkyRecompiled {VERSION}
========================
Native ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompilation port of
Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky.

QUICK START:
------------
1. Launch SkyRecompiled:
   - macOS:   Double-click SkyRecompiled.app
   - Windows: Double-click SkyRecompiled.bat
   - Linux:   Run ./SkyRecompiled (or click SkyRecompiled.desktop)
2. On first launch, a file picker dialog will prompt you to select your
   legally owned Explorers of Sky .nds ROM (clean USA or Europe).
3. Your ROM path and saves are automatically remembered.

CONTROLS:
---------
Configured in config/controls_preset.toml.
- D-Pad / Left Stick / Arrows: Move
- A / Cross / Z: Confirm / Attack
- B / Circle / X: Cancel / Run
- X / Triangle / S: Main Menu
- Y / Square / A: Rotate / Target
- L / Shoulder / Q: Diagonal Movement Lock
- R / Shoulder / E: Quick Menu

CLEAN-ROOM & LEGAL:
-------------------
This software contains zero copyrighted Nintendo DS ROM code, textures,
audio, or assets. Players must provide their own legally owned cartridge dump.
"""


def package_macos(*, without_game_banks: bool = False) -> Path:
    """Package the macOS application bundle into a distribution ZIP."""
    print(f"\033[1;36m[package:macos]\033[0m Packaging macOS Application Bundle...")
    package_script = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "package_macos_app.py"
    package_cmd = [sys.executable, str(package_script)]
    if without_game_banks:
        package_cmd.append("--without-game-banks")
    subprocess.run(package_cmd, check=True)

    app_path = BUILD_DIR / "SkyRecompiled.app"
    runner_path = app_path / "Contents" / "MacOS" / "nds_runner"
    if not runner_path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package macOS: missing {runner_path}. "
            "Build the runner with scripts/build.py before packaging."
        )
    zip_path = DIST_DIR / f"SkyRecompiled-v{VERSION}-macos-arm64.zip"
    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Creating {zip_path}...")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(app_path):
            for file in files:
                p = Path(root) / file
                arcname = p.relative_to(BUILD_DIR)
                zf.write(p, arcname)

    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:macos:done]\033[0m {zip_path} ({zip_path.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return zip_path


def verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary_path: Path) -> None:
    """Verify that the binary is a 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF executable."""
    with binary_path.open("rb") as f:
        header = f.read(20)
    if len(header) < 20 or header[:4] != b"\x7fELF":
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: {binary_path} is not a Linux ELF binary "
            "(looks like a host binary from another OS such as macOS Mach-O). "
            "Build the Linux package on a Linux x86_64 host."
        )
    ei_class = header[4]
    ei_data = header[5]
    e_type, e_machine = struct.unpack("<HH", header[16:20])
    if ei_class != 2 or ei_data != 1 or e_type not in (2, 3) or e_machine != 0x3E:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: {binary_path} is not a 64-bit x86_64 ELF executable "
            f"(EI_CLASS={ei_class}, EI_DATA={ei_data}, e_type={e_type}, e_machine=0x{e_machine:x})."
        )


def package_linux(*, without_game_banks: bool = False) -> Path:
    """Package the Linux standalone distribution into a tar.gz archive."""
    runner_dir = BUILD_DIR / ("runner-fallback" if without_game_banks else "runner")
    runner_src = runner_dir / "nds_runner"
    if not runner_src.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: missing {runner_src}. "
            "Build on Linux with scripts/build.py before packaging."
        )
    verify_linux_elf_x86_64(runner_src)

    print(f"\033[1;36m[package:linux]\033[0m Packaging Linux Standalone Distribution...")
    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pkg_dir = BUILD_DIR / f"SkyRecompiled-v{VERSION}-linux-x86_64"
    if pkg_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(pkg_dir)

    bin_dir = pkg_dir / "bin"
    cfg_dir = pkg_dir / "config"
    scripts_dir = pkg_dir / "scripts"
    bin_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cfg_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    scripts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 1. Launcher & Desktop file
    launcher_file = pkg_dir / "SkyRecompiled"
    launcher_file.write_text(LINUX_LAUNCHER, encoding="utf-8")
    launcher_file.chmod(launcher_file.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)

    desktop_file = pkg_dir / "SkyRecompiled.desktop"
    desktop_file.write_text(LINUX_DESKTOP, encoding="utf-8")

    # 2. Python launcher core
    shutil.copy2(REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "launcher.py", scripts_dir / "launcher.py")

    # 3. Config files
    shutil.copy2(CONFIG_DIR / "game.toml", cfg_dir / "game.toml")
    shutil.copy2(CONFIG_DIR / "controls_preset.toml", cfg_dir / "controls_preset.toml")

    # 4. Validated Linux x86_64 binary and optional bundled SDL3 shared libraries
    dest = bin_dir / "nds_runner"
    shutil.copy2(runner_src, dest)
    dest.chmod(dest.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
    for extra in sorted(runner_dir.glob("libSDL3.so*")):
        if extra.is_file() and not extra.is_symlink():
            shutil.copy2(extra, bin_dir / extra.name)
            if not (bin_dir / "libSDL3.so.0").exists():
                shutil.copy2(extra, bin_dir / "libSDL3.so.0")
    sdl_license = runner_dir / "SDL3-LICENSE.txt"
    if sdl_license.is_file():
        shutil.copy2(sdl_license, bin_dir / "SDL3-LICENSE.txt")

    readme = README_TEXT
    if without_game_banks:
        readme += (
            "\nThis Linux build runs cartridge code at runtime. It does not include\n"
            "statically recompiled game code. See the project README for a native\n"
            "build using your own ROM.\n"
        )
    (pkg_dir / "README.txt").write_text(readme, encoding="utf-8")

    tar_path = DIST_DIR / f"SkyRecompiled-v{VERSION}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
    with tarfile.open(tar_path, "w:gz") as tar:
        tar.add(pkg_dir, arcname=pkg_dir.name)

    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:linux:done]\033[0m {tar_path} ({tar_path.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return tar_path


def package_windows(*, without_game_banks: bool = False) -> Path:
    """Package the standalone Windows x64 ZIP distribution with runner, launcher, and SDL3 DLL."""
    runner_dir = BUILD_DIR / ("runner-fallback" if without_game_banks else "runner")
    required_files = ("nds_runner.exe", "SDL3.dll", "SDL3-LICENSE.txt")
    for name in required_files:
        if not (runner_dir / name).is_file():
            raise SystemExit(
                f"Cannot package Windows: missing {runner_dir / name}. "
                "Build on Windows with scripts/build.py and --sdl3-sdk before packaging."

def main() -> None:
    """Parse arguments and create distribution packages for specified platforms."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SkyRecompiled Release Packager")
    parser.add_argument("--platform", choices=["macos", "linux", "windows", "ios", "all"], default="all")
    parser.add_argument(

        help="macOS/Linux/Windows: package the build from build/runner-fallback",

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.without_game_banks and args.platform == "ios":

    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    host_system = platform.system()

    if args.platform == "macos" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Darwin"):

    if args.platform == "linux" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Linux"):

### Opening and using in-game settings

Press **F1** during gameplay, or press **Guide** on a controller. You can also
open settings with **Select+Start**. On iPhone or iPad, tap the **⚙** button in
the on-screen controls. The settings open on the category list:
**Video**, **Controller**, **Keyboard**, and **System**. Use the arrow keys or
D-pad to choose a category and press **Enter** or **A** to open it. Press
**Escape** or **B/Back** to return to the category list; press it again to close
settings.

In **Controller** or **Keyboard**, select an action such as **A** or **Up** and
press **Enter** or **A**. Then press the controller button, move the stick, or
press the keyboard key you want to assign. **Backspace** clears a binding;
**Escape** or **Guide** cancels assignment. Each page has a **Restore defaults**
action. On iOS, a connected keyboard or controller can assign inputs; the touch
controls remain available on screen.

### Can I play a European ROM in another language?

The European cartridge includes English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
SkyRecompiled's generated firmware currently selects English, so the European
game starts in English. A **Game language** setting is planned for Explorers
of Sky’s own options menu. It will show the languages available on your
cartridge and apply your choice on the next launch. The USA release contains
English game text.

## Quickstart (Windows x64)

You can download the pre-packaged Windows release above (which runs cartridge code at runtime) or build the runner locally with your own clean *Explorers of Sky* USA or Europe ROM to include statically recompiled game code.

Install Python 3.12+, Git for Windows (with Git Bash available on PATH), and [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/). In the **MSYS2 MINGW64** shell, install the build tools:

$env:Path = "C:\msys64\mingw64\bin;$env:Path"

After the build succeeds, `& .\build\runner\nds_runner.exe --help` checks that the runner starts. To create a local ZIP, run `python scripts/package_release.py --platform windows`. Extract the whole ZIP before opening `SkyRecompiled.bat`.

def verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary_path: Path) -> None:
    """Verify that the binary is a 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF executable."""
    with binary_path.open("rb") as f:
        header = f.read(20)
    if len(header) < 20 or header[:4] != b"\x7fELF":
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: {binary_path} is not a Linux ELF binary "
            "(looks like a host binary from another OS such as macOS Mach-O). "
            "Build the Linux package on a Linux x86_64 host."
        )
    ei_class = header[4]
    ei_data = header[5]
    e_type, e_machine = struct.unpack("<HH", header[16:20])
    if ei_class != 2 or ei_data != 1 or e_type not in (2, 3) or e_machine != 0x3E:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: {binary_path} is not a 64-bit x86_64 ELF executable "
            f"(EI_CLASS={ei_class}, EI_DATA={ei_data}, e_type={e_type}, e_machine=0x{e_machine:x})."
        )

    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(pkg_dir):
            for file in files:
                p = Path(root) / file
                arcname = p.relative_to(pkg_dir.parent)
                zf.write(p, arcname)

    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:windows:done]\033[0m {zip_path} ({zip_path.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return zip_path


def package_ios() -> Path:
    """Package the ROM-free iOS alpha IPA for distribution."""
    print(f"\033[1;36m[package:ios]\033[0m Packaging iOS Alpha IPA Distribution...")
    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ipa_source = BUILD_DIR / "ios" / "SkyRecompiled-iOS-alpha.ipa"
    if not ipa_source.is_file():
        build_ios_script = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "build_ios.py"
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(build_ios_script)], check=True)
    if not ipa_source.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"Cannot package iOS: missing {ipa_source}")

    ipa_dist = DIST_DIR / f"SkyRecompiled-v{VERSION}-ios.ipa"
    shutil.copy2(ipa_source, ipa_dist)
    print(f"\033[1;32m[package:ios:done]\033[0m {ipa_dist} ({ipa_dist.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB)")
    return ipa_dist


def main() -> None:
    """Parse arguments and create distribution packages for specified platforms."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SkyRecompiled Release Packager")
    parser.add_argument("--platform", choices=["macos", "linux", "windows", "ios", "all"], default="all")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--without-game-banks",
        action="store_true",
        help="macOS/Linux/Windows: package the build from build/runner-fallback",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.without_game_banks and args.platform == "ios":
        parser.error("--without-game-banks is not supported for --platform ios")

    DIST_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    host_system = platform.system()

    if args.platform == "macos" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Darwin"):
        package_macos(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "linux" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Linux"):
        package_linux(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "windows" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Windows"):
        package_windows(without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks)
    if args.platform == "ios" or (args.platform == "all" and host_system == "Darwin"):
        package_ios()

    print("\n\033[1;32mAll release packages generated in build/dist/\033[0m")
    for f in DIST_DIR.iterdir():
        print(f"  - {f.name} ({f.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

**SkyRecompiled** is a native ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompilation PC port of *Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky*, built on [`ndsrecomp`](https://github.com/RetroPortingToolKit/ndsrecomp) and [`pmdsky-debug`](https://github.com/UsernameFodder/pmdsky-debug).

### Downloads (v0.1.0 Alpha)

| Platform | Build Status | Package |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **macOS Apple Silicon (`arm64`)** | Verified Working | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-macos-arm64.zip](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-macos-arm64.zip) |
| **Windows (`x86_64`)** | Untested Alpha (Testers Needed!) | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-windows-x64.zip](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-windows-x64.zip) |
| **Linux (`x86_64`)** | Untested Alpha (Testers Needed!) | [SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-linux-x86_64.tar.gz](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha/SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) |

> **Clean-Room & Legal Notice:** This repository contains **zero** copyrighted Nintendo DS ROMs, extracted assets, BIOS/firmware dumps, or ROM-derived C code. Players must supply their own legally dumped *Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky* `.nds` cartridge image. No Nintendo DS BIOS or firmware files are required (`FreeBIOS` + synthesized NVRAM direct boot).

---

## Features & Roadmap

- **Milestone 1 (Pre-Alpha -- Active):** Native **macOS Apple Silicon (`arm64`)** static recompilation of all **34 executable modules** (`arm9`, `itcm`, `arm7` + WRAM/RAM drivers, and all 32 active overlays -- `91,872` recompiled functions), BIOS-free direct boot, 128 KiB FRAM/EEPROM saves, savestates, audio, and controller support.
- **Milestone 2:** Native **Windows (`x86_64`)** and **Linux (`x86_64` / `arm64`)** builds & packaging.
- **Milestone 3:** **Beyond-Emulator Graphics & Smoothness** -- True `16:9` / `21:9` native 2D widescreen (`overlay29` & `overlay11` camera/tile hooks + anchored HUD), **120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz** sub-pixel camera & sprite interpolation, and custom Apple Metal / `SDL_GPU` pixel-art & weather shaders.
- **Milestone 4:** **Launcher, SkyTemple Mod Loader & Online Rescue Board** -- Zero-recompile layered NitroFS mod overrides, SkyTemple custom ASM hack recompilation, and an asynchronous *Rescue Team DX*-style Online Rescue Bulletin Board backed by vanilla **Wonder Mail S / SOS / A-OK Mail** structs (with 54-character passwords preserved forever as an offline fallback).

See [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full technical specification.

### Opening and using in-game settings

Press **F1** during gameplay, or press **Guide** on a controller. You can also
open settings with **Select+Start**. On iPhone or iPad, tap the **⚙** button in
the on-screen controls. The settings open on the category list:
**Video**, **Controller**, **Keyboard**, and **System**. Use the arrow keys or
D-pad to choose a category and press **Enter** or **A** to open it. Press
**Escape** or **B/Back** to return to the category list; press it again to close
settings.

In **Controller** or **Keyboard**, select an action such as **A** or **Up** and
press **Enter** or **A**. Then press the controller button, move the stick, or
press the keyboard key you want to assign. **Backspace** clears a binding;
**Escape** or **Guide** cancels assignment. Each page has a **Restore defaults**
action. On iOS, a connected keyboard or controller can assign inputs; the touch
controls remain available on screen.

### Can I play a European ROM in another language?

The European cartridge includes English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
SkyRecompiled's generated firmware currently selects English, so the European
game starts in English. A **Game language** setting is planned for Explorers
of Sky’s own options menu. It will show the languages available on your
cartridge and apply your choice on the next launch. The USA release contains
English game text.

---

## Quickstart (macOS Apple Silicon)

### Prerequisites
```bash
brew install cmake ninja sdl3 python
```

### Build and launch

Supply a clean USA or Europe ROM. Bootstrap the pinned tools, compile the game,
and package the macOS app:

```bash
./scripts/setup_third_party.sh
python3 scripts/build.py --rom "/path/to/Explorers of Sky.nds" --package
open build/SkyRecompiled.app
```

For the offline translator and runtime build layout, see [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md#build-layout).

---

## Quickstart (Windows x64)

You can download the pre-packaged Windows release above (which runs cartridge code at runtime) or build the runner locally with your own clean *Explorers of Sky* USA or Europe ROM to include statically recompiled game code.

Install Python 3.12+, Git for Windows (with Git Bash available on PATH), and [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org/). In the **MSYS2 MINGW64** shell, install the build tools:

```bash
pacman -S --needed mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja
```

Extract **`SDL3-devel-3.4.14-mingw.zip`** from the [SDL3 release page](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/tag/release-3.4.14). In PowerShell, run these commands from the repository root. Adjust the paths to match your installation and ROM.

```powershell
& "${env:ProgramFiles}\Git\bin\bash.exe" scripts/setup_third_party.sh
$env:Path = "C:\msys64\mingw64\bin;$env:Path"
python scripts/build.py --sdl3-sdk "C:\path\to\SDL3-3.4.14" --rom "C:\path\to\Explorers of Sky.nds"
python scripts/launcher.py --rom "C:\path\to\Explorers of Sky.nds"
```

After the build succeeds, `& .\build\runner\nds_runner.exe --help` checks that the runner starts. To create a local ZIP, run `python scripts/package_release.py --platform windows`. Extract the whole ZIP before opening `SkyRecompiled.bat`.

---

## iPhone and iPad alpha

Download the pre-built `SkyRecompiled-v0.1.0-alpha-ios.ipa` from the [latest GitHub Releases](https://github.com/DarthMDev/pmd-sky-recomp/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha), or build from source on a Mac with Xcode, CMake, Ninja, and Python 3:

```bash
python3 scripts/build_ios.py
```

The build writes `build/ios/SkyRecompiled-iOS-alpha.ipa` (or package for distribution with `python3 scripts/package_release.py --platform ios`). The **iOS alpha IPA**
GitHub Actions workflow builds and verifies this same artifact on push to `main` and pull requests.

1. SkyRecompiled requires iOS or iPadOS 16.0 or later. Set up AltStore Classic
   on your iPhone or iPad and enable Developer Mode. [AltStore setup for macOS](https://faq.altstore.io/altstore-classic/how-to-install-altstore-macos)
2. Save the IPA to Files. In AltStore, open **My Apps**, tap **+**, and select
   the IPA. AltStore signs it for your device. Refresh it before the signing
   expires. [AltStore signing and refresh](https://faq.altstore.io/altstore-classic/your-altstore)
3. Open SkyRecompiled, choose **Import ROM from Files**, and select your own
   clean USA or Europe Explorers of Sky `.nds` dump. Tap **Compile and Play**.
   Use the on-screen controls or connect a controller. Tap **Launcher** to exit
   the game and flush pending saves.
4. In **Files → On My iPhone/iPad → SkyRecompiled**, find `Logs/latest.log`
   after launching the app and `Saves/pmdsky.sav` after the game creates a save.
   The iOS software renderer uses the native 1× resolution.

The iOS app reuses the desktop runner and compiles ROM instructions into portable
intermediate code on the device. It can run without JIT signing privileges.
This alpha uses the runner's interpreter for that code, so performance may
differ from the native desktop build.

For Apple silicon Mac testing, boot an iPhone or iPad in Simulator, then run
these commands from the repository root. Simulator sets up the runtime the
app needs at launch.

```bash
python3 scripts/build_ios.py --simulator
xcrun simctl install booted build/ios/simulator/SkyRecompiled.app
xcrun simctl launch booted dev.skyrecompiled.ios
```

Running the iOS build directly on an Apple silicon Mac requires Apple development
or distribution signing. [Apple silicon iOS app testing](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-silicon/running-your-ios-apps-in-macos)

## AI Usage & Verification Disclaimer

AI coding tools were used during the development of this project. All translated and recompiled output is rigorously verified against real Nintendo DS hardware and reference emulator behavior:
- **100% Executable Coverage:** All 34 executable modules (`arm9`, `itcm`, `arm7` + WRAM/RAM drivers, and all 32 active overlays -- 91,872 functions) compile natively with zero unimplemented instructions.
- **Hardware-Synced Logic:** Over 99.9% of guest instructions execute through native static C code with zero RAM code rejects. Game logic, turn execution, deterministic RNG, and cartridge FRAM/EEPROM saves are verified against hardware behavior and melonDS references via automated test suites.

      - name: Run PMDSky Bindings Generator & Full Test Suite

      - name: Set up SDL3 SDK

          echo "30d4aa2b3037718142b32dffd4e72f917ebb6cc5227150e7bb9c45efb2153aeb  $RUNNER_TEMP/SDL3-3.4.14.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/SDL3-3.4.14.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          cmake -S "$RUNNER_TEMP/SDL3-3.4.14" -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdl3-build" -G Ninja \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$RUNNER_TEMP/sdl3-install" \

          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdl3-build"
          cmake --install "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdl3-build"

  # ── Windows (x86_64 MinGW) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-windows:
    name: Windows (x86_64 MinGW)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"

      - name: Set up MinGW
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        id: msys2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          install: >-
            mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja

      - name: Add MinGW tools to PATH
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          MSYS2_LOCATION: ${{ steps.msys2.outputs.msys2-location }}
        run: Join-Path $env:MSYS2_LOCATION "mingw64/bin" >> $env:GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Bootstrap Third-Party Dependencies

          bash ./scripts/setup_third_party.sh

      - name: Run PMDSky Bindings Generator & Full Test Suite
        shell: bash

          python3 translator/gen_pmdsky_bindings.py --strict
          python3 -m unittest discover tests/

      - name: Set up SDL3 MinGW SDK
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $archive = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "SDL3-devel-3.4.14-mingw.zip"
          Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.4.14/SDL3-devel-3.4.14-mingw.zip" -OutFile $archive
          if ((Get-FileHash $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne "5f43d6dfadaf13c63c8f52a9f8a31bcfd497faeb569cae9ba6165126d1ebb960") {
            throw "SDL3 SDK checksum mismatch"
          }
          Expand-Archive $archive -DestinationPath $env:RUNNER_TEMP

      # CI has no ROM. The Windows ZIP runs cartridge code through the runtime.
      - name: Build, Package, and Smoke Test Windows Distribution
        shell: pwsh

          python scripts/build.py --without-game-banks --sdl3-sdk "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/SDL3-3.4.14"

          $launcher = Join-Path $testDir "$($zip.BaseName)/SkyRecompiled.ps1"
          # Check that the executable loads with its bundled DLL and Windows system DLLs.
          $env:PATH = "$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot"

          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Run Static Recompiler Test Suite
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          cmake --build build/cmake/recompiler
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          ctest --test-dir build/cmake/recompiler --output-on-failure

          if-no-files-found: warn

## Features & Roadmap

- **Milestone 1 (Pre-Alpha -- Active):** Native **macOS Apple Silicon (`arm64`)** static recompilation of all **34 executable modules** (`arm9`, `itcm`, `arm7` + WRAM/RAM drivers, and all 32 active overlays -- `91,872` recompiled functions), BIOS-free direct boot, 128 KiB FRAM/EEPROM saves, savestates, audio, and controller support.
- **Milestone 2:** Native **Windows (`x86_64`)** and **Linux (`x86_64` / `arm64`)** builds & packaging.
- **Milestone 3:** **Beyond-Emulator Graphics & Smoothness** -- True `16:9` / `21:9` native 2D widescreen (`overlay29` & `overlay11` camera/tile hooks + anchored HUD), **120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz** sub-pixel camera & sprite interpolation, and custom Apple Metal / `SDL_GPU` pixel-art & weather shaders.
- **Milestone 4:** **Launcher, SkyTemple Mod Loader & Online Rescue Board** -- Zero-recompile layered NitroFS mod overrides, SkyTemple custom ASM hack recompilation, and an asynchronous *Rescue Team DX*-style Online Rescue Bulletin Board backed by vanilla **Wonder Mail S / SOS / A-OK Mail** structs (with 54-character passwords preserved forever as an offline fallback).

See [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full technical specification.

python scripts/build.py --sdl3-sdk "C:\path\to\SDL3-3.4.14" --rom "C:\path\to\Explorers of Sky.nds"
python scripts/launcher.py --rom "C:\path\to\Explorers of Sky.nds"
```

After the build succeeds, `& .\build\runner\nds_runner.exe --help` checks that the runner starts. To create a local ZIP, run `python scripts/package_release.py --platform windows`. Extract the whole ZIP before opening `SkyRecompiled.bat`.

        raise SystemExit(

    parser.add_argument("--build-type", choices=["Release", "Debug", "RelWithDebInfo"], default="Release")
    parser.add_argument("--jobs", "-j", type=int, default=multiprocessing.cpu_count(), help="Parallel build jobs")
    parser.add_argument("--region", choices=["NA", "EU", "dual", "auto"], default="auto", help="Cartridge region target")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-recompile", action="store_true", help="Skip prepare_rom.py if banks exist")
    parser.add_argument("--sdl3-sdk", type=Path, help="Windows/Linux: SDL3 development SDK or install prefix folder")
    parser.add_argument("--without-game-banks", action="store_true", help="Build in build/runner-fallback without a ROM or statically compiled game banks")
    parser.add_argument("--package", action="store_true", help="Package macOS SkyRecompiled.app bundle")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        if args.sdl3_sdk is None:
            parser.error("Windows builds require --sdl3-sdk pointing to the extracted SDL3 MinGW SDK.")
        args.sdl3_sdk = args.sdl3_sdk.resolve()
        for relative in ("cmake/SDL3Config.cmake", SDL3_WINDOWS_DLL, "LICENSE.txt"):
            if not (args.sdl3_sdk / relative).is_file():
                parser.error(f"SDL3 MinGW SDK file missing: {args.sdl3_sdk / relative}")
    elif args.sdl3_sdk is not None:
        args.sdl3_sdk = args.sdl3_sdk.resolve()
        if not args.sdl3_sdk.is_dir():
            parser.error(f"SDL3 SDK prefix directory does not exist: {args.sdl3_sdk}")

    if args.clean:
        log("Cleaning build directory...")
        if BUILD_DIR.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(BUILD_DIR)

    generate_freebios(recompiler_bin)

    if not args.without_game_banks:
        if args.skip_recompile and any(GENERATED_BANKS_DIR.glob("*_dispatch.c")):
            log("Skipping ROM extraction (game banks already present).")
        else:
            rom_path = find_rom(args.rom)
            compile_game_banks(rom_path, recompiler_bin, forced_region=args.region if args.region in ("NA", "EU") else None)

    runner_bin = build_runner(
        args.jobs, args.build_type, region_mode=args.region,
        sdl3_sdk=args.sdl3_sdk, without_game_banks=args.without_game_banks,
    )

    if not args.without_game_banks and (args.package or platform.system() == "Darwin"):
        log("Packaging macOS application bundle...")
        package_script = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "package_macos_app.py"
        if package_script.exists():

        else:

def verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary_path: Path) -> None:
    """Verify that the binary is a 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF executable."""
    with binary_path.open("rb") as f:
        header = f.read(20)
    if len(header) < 20 or header[:4] != b"\x7fELF":
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Cannot package Linux: {binary_path} is not a Linux ELF binary "
            "(looks like a host binary from another OS such as macOS Mach-O). "

# Sky Recomp - Native PC Recompilation

Sky Recomp is a native cross-platform port (Windows, Linux, and macOS) based on static AArch64 -> C recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD.

Development status: experimental. Full-game stability has not been established. Crashes, menu freezes and rendering differences are still being investigated. Use the diagnostic log to report a problem; see the review of reported issues for confirmed changes and remaining checks.

Source folders and local runtime files are described in Repository layout.

Important

No game files are included. Sky Recomp requires your own legally obtained copy of the game files for The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD (v1.0.0, without updates). Instructions on how to obtain these files will NOT be provided. This project consists exclusively of the open-source static recompiler tooling, compatibility layers, and the native runtime.

## Port Features

  * Native C/C++ Execution: This is NOT an emulator (no JIT or dynamic interpretation). --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Extract the chosen Windows package into a fresh folder and open `skyrecomp.exe`. Both downloads require your own prepared game files and contain no precompiled game code. Linux and macOS downloads retain their standard package contents. The launcher uses v2.2.0 for the requested 2.2 release.

Visual pack credits: Textures and presets by Henriko Magnifico; ReShade by Patrick Mours and contributors. Credits and the ReShade license are also included in the complete Windows ZIP.

## Thanks

Thank you to Wesley-Playz for the game-version and Archipelago contribution, and to all contributors and users reporting issues and testing fixes. Existing upstream and artwork credits remain applicable.

## Known limits and reporting problems

Support for v1.0.1 and Archipelago is experimental. A complete game playthrough and a live Archipelago multiworld session have not been verified for this release. Not all address-specific gameplay options have verified v1.0.1 equivalents; the v1.0.0 cheat patches are deliberately left out of that build.

Report problems through GitHub Issues. Include v2.2.0, the game version, operating system, controller, mods and their order, and steps to reproduce. On Windows, attach `skyrecomp.log` from beside the executable. If the game freezes, wait at least 15 seconds before copying the log, and preserve it before relaunching. On Linux/macOS, also include terminal output or the available system crash report. Never attach game executables or console keys.

## Sky Recomp v2.1.0 (v2.1)

v2.1.0

`ad649b4`

The port's settings interface remains in English.
  * Fixed identified macOS screen-clearing crashes and shader transparency handling, and improved game setup on Apple Silicon.
  * Added Linux AppImage packaging with the required video libraries, alongside the existing Linux archives.
  * Corrected font packaging and included missing third-party license notices.
  * Updated the launcher version to 1.0.6.

## Crash and freeze reports: please include your log

Windows now opens a separate SkyRecomp diagnostics console and writes skyrecomp.log next to skyrecomp.exe. Closing that console does not close the game. It remains available after a crash.

If the game freezes:

  1. Wait at least 15 seconds so the automatic diagnostic report can be written. Long loading can also produce a possible-freeze report; tell us what was happening.
  2. Copy skyrecomp.log before launching again — the next normal launch replaces it.
  3. Open an issue and attach the log. Include v1.0.6, your operating system, CPU/GPU, graphics driver, location, action, controller, language and frame-rate setting, plus whether 4K Textures and ReShade were enabled.
  4. Add a screenshot and a save near the problem if available. Check logs for personal paths before sharing. Linux/macOS users can attach captured terminal output and system crash reports.

Logs are not uploaded automatically. More diagnostic details.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unit tests for the pmdsky-debug C++20 symbol binding generator."""

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
GEN_SCRIPT = REPO_ROOT / "translator" / "gen_pmdsky_bindings.py"
CPP_TEST = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "pmdsky_bindings_test.cpp"


class TestPMDSkyBindings(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verifies header generation and C++20 constexpr assertions for pmdsky_addrs.hpp."""

    def test_generator_writes_default_header(self):
        """Generate a fresh header using the default input and output paths."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            script = root / "translator" / GEN_SCRIPT.name
            script.parent.mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(GEN_SCRIPT, script)
            symbols = root / "third_party" / "pmdsky-debug" / "symbols"
            symbols.mkdir(parents=True)
            (symbols / "arm9.yml").write_text(
                "- name: NitroMain\n  address:\n    NA: 0x02123456\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, f"Generator failed: {result.stderr}")
            header = root / "include" / "skyrecomp" / "pmdsky_addrs.hpp"
            self.assertIn(".NitroMain = 0x02123456,", header.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_cpp20_compilation_and_assertions(self):
        """Compile the bindings as C++20 and run their address assertions."""
        # Compile with clang++ -std=c++20
        bin_path = REPO_ROOT / "build" / "test_pmdsky_bindings"
        bin_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        compile_cmd = [
            "clang++",
            "-std=c++20",
            f"-I{REPO_ROOT / 'include'}",
            str(CPP_TEST),
            "-o", str(bin_path),
        ]
        res = subprocess.run(compile_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(res.returncode, 0, f"Compilation failed: {res.stderr}")

        # Run test executable
        run_res = subprocess.run([str(bin_path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(run_res.returncode, 0, f"Test execution failed: {run_res.stderr}")
        self.assertIn("ALL C++20 ASSERTIONS PASSED", run_res.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unit tests for release packaging and Linux ELF binary validation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

import scripts.launcher as launcher
import scripts.package_release as package_release


def make_elf64_x86_64_header() -> bytes:
    """Construct a minimal valid 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF header."""
    e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
    # e_type=ET_EXEC (2), e_machine=EM_X86_64 (0x3E), e_version=1
    return e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 2, 0x3E, 1) + b"\x00" * 40


def make_macho_arm64_header() -> bytes:
    """Construct a minimal 64-bit arm64 Mach-O magic header."""
    # MH_MAGIC_64 (0xFEEDFACF), CPU_TYPE_ARM64 (0x0100000C)
    return struct.pack("<II", 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C) + b"\x00" * 24


class TestPackageRelease(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify that Linux release packaging validates ELF binaries and rejects foreign binaries."""

    def test_verify_linux_elf_accepts_x86_64_elf(self) -> None:
        """Accept a valid 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF binary."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            binary.write_bytes(make_elf64_x86_64_header())
            package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_macos_macho(self) -> None:
        """Reject a macOS arm64 Mach-O binary when packaging for Linux."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            binary.write_bytes(make_macho_arm64_header())
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("not a Linux ELF binary", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_wrong_arch(self) -> None:
        """Reject an ELF binary targeting a non-x86_64 architecture (e.g. EM_AARCH64=0xB7)."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
            binary.write_bytes(e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 2, 0xB7, 1))
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("not a 64-bit x86_64 ELF executable", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_non_executable_type(self) -> None:
        """Reject a relocatable ELF object file (ET_REL=1) even if x86_64."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
            binary.write_bytes(e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 1, 0x3E, 1))
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("e_type=1", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_launcher_discovers_packaged_linux_layout(self) -> None:
        """Verify find_binary_and_config locates bin/nds_runner and config/game.toml from scripts/launcher.py."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            pkg_root = Path(tmp) / f"SkyRecompiled-v{package_release.VERSION}-linux-x86_64"
            (pkg_root / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
            (pkg_root / "config").mkdir(parents=True)
            (pkg_root / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
            runner_file = pkg_root / "bin" / "nds_runner"
            config_file = pkg_root / "config" / "game.toml"
            fake_launcher = pkg_root / "scripts" / "launcher.py"
            runner_file.write_bytes(make_elf64_x86_64_header())
            config_file.write_text("[game]\n", encoding="utf-8")
            fake_launcher.write_text("# stub\n", encoding="utf-8")

            with mock.patch.object(launcher, "__file__", str(fake_launcher)), \
                 mock.patch.object(launcher.platform, "system", return_value="Linux"):
                found_runner, found_config = launcher.find_binary_and_config()
                self.assertEqual(found_runner.resolve(), runner_file.resolve())
                self.assertEqual(found_config.resolve(), config_file.resolve())

    def test_package_linux_requires_runner_binary(self) -> None:
        """Fail when build/runner/nds_runner is missing instead of creating an empty archive."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_build = Path(tmp) / "build"
            fake_dist = fake_build / "dist"
            with mock.patch.object(package_release, "BUILD_DIR", fake_build), \
                 mock.patch.object(package_release, "DIST_DIR", fake_dist):
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                    package_release.package_linux(without_game_banks=True)
                self.assertIn("Cannot package Linux: missing", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_package_linux_bundles_verified_elf_and_sdl3(self) -> None:
        """Package a verified Linux x86_64 ELF binary and bundled libSDL3.so.0."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_build = Path(tmp) / "build"
            fake_dist = fake_build / "dist"
            runner_dir = fake_build / "runner-fallback"
            runner_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
            (runner_dir / "nds_runner").write_bytes(make_elf64_x86_64_header())
            (runner_dir / "libSDL3.so.0").write_bytes(b"FAKE_SDL3_SO")
            (runner_dir / "SDL3-LICENSE.txt").write_text("Zlib License\n", encoding="utf-8")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unit tests for release packaging and Linux ELF binary validation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

import scripts.launcher as launcher
import scripts.package_release as package_release


def make_elf64_x86_64_header() -> bytes:
    """Construct a minimal valid 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF header."""
    e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
    # e_type=ET_EXEC (2), e_machine=EM_X86_64 (0x3E), e_version=1
    return e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 2, 0x3E, 1) + b"\x00" * 40


def make_macho_arm64_header() -> bytes:
    """Construct a minimal 64-bit arm64 Mach-O magic header."""
    # MH_MAGIC_64 (0xFEEDFACF), CPU_TYPE_ARM64 (0x0100000C)
    return struct.pack("<II", 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C) + b"\x00" * 24


class TestPackageRelease(unittest.TestCase):
    """Verify that Linux release packaging validates ELF binaries and rejects foreign binaries."""

    def test_verify_linux_elf_accepts_x86_64_elf(self) -> None:
        """Accept a valid 64-bit little-endian x86_64 ELF binary."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            binary.write_bytes(make_elf64_x86_64_header())
            package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_macos_macho(self) -> None:
        """Reject a macOS arm64 Mach-O binary when packaging for Linux."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            binary.write_bytes(make_macho_arm64_header())
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("not a Linux ELF binary", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_wrong_arch(self) -> None:
        """Reject an ELF binary targeting a non-x86_64 architecture (e.g. EM_AARCH64=0xB7)."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
            binary.write_bytes(e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 2, 0xB7, 1))
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("not a 64-bit x86_64 ELF executable", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_verify_linux_elf_rejects_non_executable_type(self) -> None:
        """Reject a relocatable ELF object file (ET_REL=1) even if x86_64."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            binary = Path(tmp) / "nds_runner"
            e_ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1]) + b"\x00" * 9
            binary.write_bytes(e_ident + struct.pack("<HHI", 1, 0x3E, 1))
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                package_release.verify_linux_elf_x86_64(binary)
            self.assertIn("e_type=1", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_launcher_discovers_packaged_linux_layout(self) -> None:
        """Verify find_binary_and_config locates bin/nds_runner and config/game.toml from scripts/launcher.py."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            pkg_root = Path(tmp) / f"SkyRecompiled-v{package_release.VERSION}-linux-x86_64"
            (pkg_root / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
            (pkg_root / "config").mkdir(parents=True)
            (pkg_root / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
            runner_file = pkg_root / "bin" / "nds_runner"
            config_file = pkg_root / "config" / "game.toml"
            fake_launcher = pkg_root / "scripts" / "launcher.py"
            runner_file.write_bytes(make_elf64_x86_64_header())
            config_file.write_text("[game]\n", encoding="utf-8")
            fake_launcher.write_text("# stub\n", encoding="utf-8")

            with mock.patch.object(launcher, "__file__", str(fake_launcher)), \
                 mock.patch.object(launcher.platform, "system", return_value="Linux"):
                found_runner, found_config = launcher.find_binary_and_config()
                self.assertEqual(found_runner.resolve(), runner_file.resolve())
                self.assertEqual(found_config.resolve(), config_file.resolve())

    def test_package_linux_requires_runner_binary(self) -> None:
        """Fail when build/runner/nds_runner is missing instead of creating an empty archive."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_build = Path(tmp) / "build"
            fake_dist = fake_build / "dist"
            with mock.patch.object(package_release, "BUILD_DIR", fake_build), \
                 mock.patch.object(package_release, "DIST_DIR", fake_dist):
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as ctx:
                    package_release.package_linux(without_game_banks=True)
                self.assertIn("Cannot package Linux: missing", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_package_linux_bundles_verified_elf_and_sdl3(self) -> None:
        """Package a verified Linux x86_64 ELF binary and bundled libSDL3.so.0."""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            fake_build = Path(tmp) / "build"
            fake_dist = fake_build / "dist"
            runner_dir = fake_build / "runner-fallback"
            runner_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

            (runner_dir / "libSDL3.so.0").write_bytes(b"FAKE_SDL3_SO")
            (runner_dir / "SDL3-LICENSE.txt").write_text("Zlib License\n", encoding="utf-8")

    name: macOS (Apple Silicon arm64)
          $env:PATH = "$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot"
          & "$env:SystemRoot\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $launcher -CheckRunner
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Run Static Recompiler Test Suite
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          cmake --build build/cmake/recompiler
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          ctest --test-dir build/cmake/recompiler --output-on-failure

      - name: Upload Windows Recompiler Binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: skyrecompiled-recompiler-windows-x64
          path: build/recompiler/nds_recompile.exe
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Upload Windows Distribution Package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: skyrecompiled-dist-windows-x64
          path: build/dist/SkyRecompiled-*-windows-x64.zip
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ── iOS (device arm64) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-ios:
    name: iOS (device arm64)
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Build ROM-free iOS IPA
        run: python3 scripts/build_ios.py

      - name: Package versioned IPA
        run: python3 scripts/package_release.py --platform ios

      - name: Upload iOS Distribution Package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: skyrecompiled-dist-ios
          path: build/dist/SkyRecompiled-*-ios.ipa
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish-release:
    name: Publish prerelease and platform packages
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: [build-macos, build-linux, build-windows, build-ios]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download platform packages
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: skyrecompiled-dist-*
          path: build/dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Verify complete package set
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          files=(
            "build/dist/SkyRecompiled-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-macos-arm64.zip"
            "build/dist/SkyRecompiled-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-windows-x64.zip"
            "build/dist/SkyRecompiled-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
            "build/dist/SkyRecompiled-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-ios.ipa"
          )
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            test -s "$file" || { echo "Missing release package: $file" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

      - name: Publish GitHub prerelease
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md" <<'EOF'
          ## What's new in v0.2.0-alpha

          This release includes the Milestone 3 graphics/runtime work since v0.1.0-alpha:

          - Native 16:10, 16:9, and 21:9 widescreen rendering, expanded camera/tile streaming, anchored HUD, and hybrid single-window layout.
          - High-refresh camera and entity interpolation for 120Hz, 144Hz, 240Hz, and uncapped VRR.
          - Pixel-art filters, LCD/CRT effects, and weather-aware dungeon lighting.
          - In-game Video, Controller, Keyboard, and System settings with assignable inputs, controller presets, defaults, and persistence.
          - iPhone and iPad support with ROM import, on-device compilation, touch controls, Files-accessible saves/logs, and a settings gear.

          All packages are ROM-free. Provide your own legally dumped Explorers of Sky ROM. Desktop release packages execute cartridge code at runtime.

          This is an alpha release. Windows and Linux packages pass automated build and smoke checks; gameplay has not been manually verified on every platform.
          EOF

- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.

The tool result will include documentation and, when creating or selecting a tab or selecting an app, its initial UI state. Selecting a browser does not open a tab. Read that result before continuing.

For an existing tab identified by URL in browser context (including the current IAB tab):

- `"mcpapps"`: use `cua.getBrowser({ id: "mcpapps" })` for existing full-screen MCP Apps in the task’s side panel.
- `"iab"` (in-app browser): in `createBrowserTab`, use `visible: true` to show the browser; `false` to keep it hidden.
- `"dot"` (Dot): use only when present in browser inventory. It accesses tabs on Dot's active main thread. `cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: "dot" })` claims an existing tab; `cua.createBrowserTab("dot", url, { visible: boolean })` creates one with the same visibility options as `"iab"`.
- `"chrome"` (@Chrome), `"edge"` (@Edge): pass a short, emoji-prefixed `sessionName` (e.g. `"🔎 Task"`) to `createBrowserTab` when starting a task.

If your context begins with a summary of an existing computer use task, call `await cua.rewriteDocumentation()` before continuing the computer use task to ensure you have a complete view of the necessary documentation.

Several `cua_repl.js` calls may work toward the same goal. As soon as you observe the final outcome of the CUA part of the task, make your next tool call `cua_repl.js` with only `completion_summary`, exactly once. Do this before using another tool for the next part of the user’s request or sending your reply, even if the overall request continues. If you hand control to the user, wait to summarize until the handoff has ended and you’ve observed the final outcome of the CUA part of the task. This tool is part of plugin `unified-computer-use`.
